numbering: Episodes numbered 1-13 in broadcast order (single season).

arcs.name: Café LycoReco
arcs.summary: Disgraced Lycoris agent Takina is sent to a café to work with the carefree Chisato.
events: Takina is dismissed from DA and joins Chisato at Café LycoReco.
Hacker Kurumi fakes her death and joins the team.

arcs.name: Majima Emerges
arcs.summary: Terrorist Majima comes onto the scene as violence in Tokyo grows.

arcs.name: The Alan Institute
arcs.summary: Chisato's past with the mysterious Alan Institute surfaces.
events: Chisato learns Yoshimatsu saved her life.
Chisato's artificial heart is damaged, leaving her months to live.

arcs.name: Recoil
arcs.summary: Majima's plan to expose DA brings Chisato and Takina to a final showdown.
events: Majima hides guns across Tokyo and exposes DA live.
Takina saves Chisato in her final duel with Majima, Yoshimatsu dies, and the team ends up in Hawaii.

filler.note: Anime original, so there's no filler.
